Eligible patients have to have superficial tumors. We are treating the following types: Dogs with large mast cell tumors (>2 cm) Dogs with soft tissue sarcomas (<2cm in diameter) Dogs with oral melanoma (2-3cm diameter) Dogs with cutaneous or footpad melanoma (<2cm) Cats with oral squamous cell carcinoma not involving the bone Cats with other cutaneous tumors like Mast cell tumors, Sarcomas or Carcinomas This clinical trial utilizes gold nanoparticles in a gross disease setting.
